block.description: Provider for local [Git](https://git-scm.com/) operations. Requires Terraform 1.0 or later.

add_paths.description: The paths to add to the Git index. Values can be exact paths or glob patterns.

directory.description: The path to the local Git repository.

id.description: The timestamp of the last addition in Unix nanoseconds.

block.description: Add file contents to the index similar to `git add`.

bearer.description: Configure HTTP bearer token authentication. **Note**: Services like GitHub use basic auth with your OAuth2 personal access token as the password.

known_hosts.description: The list of known hosts files to accept. If none are specified, system defaults will be used.

username.description: The system username of the user talking to the SSH agent. Use an empty string in order to automatically fetch this.

private_key_pem.description: The private SSH key in PEM format.

known_hosts.description: The list of known hosts files to accept. If none are specified, system defaults will be used.

auth.description: The authentication credentials, if required, to use with the remote repository.

bare.description: Whether we should perform a bare clone. Defaults to `false`.

ca_bundle_file_path.description: File system path to an additional CA bundle to use together with the system cert pool.

insecure_skip_tls.description: Skip SSL verification if protocol is HTTPS.

url.description: The (possibly remote) repository URL to clone from.

block.description: Clones a Git repository similar to `git clone`.

all.description: Automatically stage files that have been modified and deleted, but new files you have not told Git about are not affected. Defaults to `false`.

allow_empty_commits.description: Enable empty commits to be created. Defaults to `true`.

email.description: The email address of the author.

author.description: The original author of the commit. If none is specified, the author will be read from the Git configuration.

email.description: The email address of the committer.

committer.description: The person performing the commit. If none is specified, the author is used as committer.

sha1.description: The SHA1 hash of the created commit.

author_email.description: The email address of the author of a commit.

block.description: Reads the configuration of a Git repository.

all.description: Pretend as if all the refs in `refs/`, along with `HEAD`, are listed. It is equivalent to running `git log --all`. If set to `true`, the `from` attribute will be ignored.

commits.description: The resulting commit SHA1 hashes ordered as specified by the `order` attribute.

directory.description: The path to the local Git repository.

filter_paths.description: Show only commits that are enough to explain how the files that match the specified paths came to be. Note that these are not Git `pathspec` but rather Go [path matchers](https://pkg.go.dev/path#Match) thus you have to add `/*` for directories yourself.

from.description: When set the log will only contain commits reachable from it. If this option is not set, `HEAD` will be used as the default. Can be any [revision](https://www.git-scm.com/docs/gitrevisions) that `go-git` [supports](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-git/go-git/v5#Repository.ResolveRevision).

id.description: The same value as the `directory` attribute.

max_count.description: Limit the number of commits to output.

order.description: The traversal algorithm to use while listing commits. Defaults to `time` which is similar to `git log`. Other values are `depth` and `breadth` for depth- or breadth-first traversal.

since.description: Show commits more recent than a specific date. Date must be in RFC 3339 format, e.g. by using the built-in [timestamp](https://www.terraform.io/language/functions/timestamp)/[timeadd](https://www.terraform.io/language/functions/timeadd) functions.

skip.description: Skip first number of commits in output.

until.description: Show commits older than a specific date. Date must be in RFC 3339 format, e.g. by using the built-in [timestamp](https://www.terraform.io/language/functions/timestamp)/[timeadd](https://www.terraform.io/language/functions/timeadd) functions.
